steps.title: Welcome!
steps.text: The guitar has 6 strings, a fretted neck and a body that amplifies the sound. The strings are numbered from the thinnest (1st, high E) to the thickest (6th, low E).

steps.prompt: How many strings does a standard guitar have?

steps.title: Sitting posture
steps.text: Sit up straight, rest the guitar on your right leg (right-handed). The neck points slightly upward. The thumb of the left hand goes behind the neck.

steps.title: Right hand
steps.text: The thumb (p), index (i), middle (m) and ring (a) fingers play the strings. Start by playing an open string with your thumb, from top to bottom.

steps.prompt: Where does the thumb of the left hand go?

steps.title: EADGBE tuning
steps.text: From the thickest string to the thinnest: E - A - D - G - B - E. Mnemonic: 'Eddie Ate Dynamite, Good Bye Eddie'.
Tune the 6th string (low E). Play the string and adjust the tuner until the tuner reads green.

steps.text: Tune the 1st string (high E).

steps.title: Play open
steps.text: Play the 1st string (the thinnest) with the index finger of your right hand. It should sound clear and sustained. If you fret, press closer to the fret.

steps.text: This is how the 1st open string (E) should sound.

steps.title: Frets
steps.text: Each fret goes up a semitone. On the 1st string: fret 0 = E, 1 = F, 2 = F#, 3 = G.
